summary_en: 960,000 shares (6.29% of S/O ex-treasury) authorized for acquisition up to ¥4.3B via ToSTNeT-3 and open-market purchase. Execution window 21 July 2026 to 31 March 2027.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock (Acquisition of Treasury Stock under Articles of Incorporation Pursuant to Article 165, Paragraph 2, Companies Act)
translation_en_brief: SRA Holdings announced a treasury-stock acquisition program on 17 July 2026. The board authorized acquisition of up to 960,000 shares (6.29% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) at a total cost not exceeding ¥4.3 billion. Execution is via two methods: ToSTNeT-3 (off-exchange purchase) and open-market purchase (立会内市場買付). The window runs from 21 July 2026 through 31 March 2027. The stated rationale is to execute flexible capital policy responsive to changing business conditions, enhance shareholder returns, and improve capital efficiency.
